title: Home screen: session list with status and delete
description: Show all saved sessions, newest first, so recordings persist visibly across restarts (goal 3).
steps: Create `ui/home/HomeViewModel.kt`: constructor `(repository: SessionRepository)`; `val sessions: StateFlow<List<SessionRow>>` from `observeAll()` mapped to `data class SessionRow(val id: Long, val title: String, val subtitle: String, val status: SessionStatus)`, `stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5000), emptyList())`. `fun delete(id: Long)` launches `repository.deleteSession(id)`.

Pure top-level function `fun sessionSubtitle(createdAt: Long, durationMs: Long, status: SessionStatus, zone: ZoneId = ZoneId.systemDefault()): String` → `"16 Oct 2026, 14:05 · 12:34"` (pattern `d MMM yyyy, HH:mm`, Locale.UK, duration mm:ss or h:mm:ss) followed by `" · Recording…"` for RECORDING, `" · Identifying speakers…"` for DIARIZING, `" · Speaker detection failed"` for DIARIZATION_FAILED, nothing otherwise.

Rewrite `HomeScreen`: top bar "ConvoScribe" with a settings icon button (`Icons.Filled.Settings`) navigating to route `settings` (add a placeholder composable for `settings` in `AppNavHost` if it does not exist yet), a `LazyColumn` of `ListItem`s (headline title, supporting subtitle) that navigate to `session/{id}` on click, long-press (`combinedClickable`) opens an `AlertDialog` "Delete this session?" with "Delete"/"Cancel". Empty state text "No sessions yet. Tap New recording to start.". Keep the existing FAB behaviour.
acceptanceCriteria: Test: `sessionSubtitle(0L, 754_000, TRANSCRIBED, UTC) == "1 Jan 1970, 00:00 · 12:34"` and DIARIZING adds `" · Identifying speakers…"`
Test: HomeViewModel emits sessions newest first; `delete(id)` removes it from the emitted list
